_meta.purpose: Source-markup signatures -> target block (+ variant). Consulted at scope time to decide block REUSE deterministically. Structure decides the TEMPLATE; these signatures decide the BLOCKS.
rules: A signature QUALIFIES a region as a block family. It does NOT address the region — the per-page `instances` selector (positional, e.g. :nth-of-type) is still captured per page.
One block, many variants: a source class maps to a block NAME + optional VARIANT. In DA the block is authored as `Block` or `Block (variant)`; there is never a separate block per variant.
If a region matches NO signature here, it is a NEW-BLOCK candidate — flag it in the Template Reuse Report and get approval before building.
A matched family does not guarantee behavior parity: a genuinely new variant (e.g. a real carousel) may still need block work even though it maps to an existing family.
